name: Dreamforge
long_description: We believe that 3D printing will fundamentally reshape our relationship with the products and items we use. At Dreamforge, we'll strive to show our beliefs in big ways and small in the products we build and in the example we set.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Visiting Partner at Y Combinator and YCS12 founder. Support on all things, but especially crypto and broader fintech.

Previously, built the future of crypto at Coinbase over 7 years: helping lead USDC to $1 BN, leading Coinbase's asset strategy, launching staking, managing billions of dollars in funds through secure wallet tech, leading Coinbase's developer products (cdp.coinbase.com), and launching x402 (x402.org). Formerly, worked with banks + insurance companies.
